newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian group awards stadium contracts.
newsitem.headline: Australian group awards stadium contracts.

text.p: The Stadium Australia Group said on Thursday that it had awarded a number of operating agreements covering catering beverage and ticketing rights at the stadium which is to be used for the 2000 Olympics.

Stadium Australia, which is seeking to raise A$364.4 million through the public sale of passes to attend Sydney 2000 Games, said all the contracts excluded the period when the Olympic games were to be held.
Stadium Australia said Ogden IFC has been awarded the operator of the Stadium for an initial term of 10 years from the opening date of the stadium, the staduium is expected to be opened in 1999.
It said Gardner Merchant has been awarded a 10 year catering contract for the stadium with options for a longer term.

Stadium Australia said the other contracts included Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd, which is to supply the stadium non alcholic beverages, and Tooheys Brewing Company, a unit of Lyon Nathan, which is to supply alcholic beverages to the stadium.
The final contract was for the exclusive rights for the ticketing for events at the stadium to Australia booking agent Ticketek, owned by Kerry Packer Consolidated Press Holdings, for over 10 years.
Ogden IFC is a joint venture between Ogden Corp of the United States and Queensland Leisure Pty Ltd.
